item.title: reports: per-account, per-currency totals
item.brief: Repository: reports (Python). It reads the ledger CSV on stdin and prints per-account totals. Change it to total per account and currency. Output header: account,currency,total_cents, rows sorted by account then currency. Input CSV without a currency column (old ledger output) counts as USD. A malformed currency code (must be exactly three uppercase ASCII letters) prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Validate at the input boundary. Keep python3 -m unittest passing, add tests for the new behaviour (old format, multi-currency totals, sorting, malformed code exit 2), update the README, and commit in this repository. Do not push. The shared CSV contract is in the initiative contract.

pr.body: Approach: totals keyed by (account, currency). currency_of() validates the code at the input boundary with re.fullmatch of [A-Z]{3}; a missing column defaults to USD. MalformedCurrencyError is raised and main() turns it into a stderr message and exit 2 before any output is written. Key files: reports.py, test_reports.py, README.md. Output header changes to account,currency,total_cents, which breaks callers that parse the old header. No asserts added, matching the existing file. Not pushed.

item.title: ledger: add currency column
item.brief: Repository: ledger (Rust). It converts a TSV of transactions on stdin into CSV on stdout. Add the optional fourth TSV column, the ISO 4217 currency code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters). If it is missing, the currency is USD. The CSV header becomes date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row gets its currency. A malformed currency code must print an error naming the line number to stderr and exit with status 2; other input errors keep exiting with status 1. Validate at the input boundary. Keep cargo test passing, add tests for the new behaviour (missing column defaults to USD, valid code, malformed code gives exit 2 with line number), update the README, and commit in this repository. Do not push. The shared CSV contract is in the initiative contract.

reasons: sizer: ordinary -> medium; unchanged: the learned route's effort

evidence.caption: Before: current CLI output for valid input and a bad amount
After: malformed currency code exits 2 with its line number on stderr

pr.body: Approach: parse_line accepts 3 or 4 TSV fields; a missing fourth field defaults to USD (DEFAULT_CURRENCY). parse_currency validates exactly three ASCII uppercase letters and returns ParseError::BadCurrency. Other parse failures are ParseError::Invalid. main maps BadCurrency to exit 2 and Invalid to exit 1, and prints 'line N:' on stderr for both. to_csv_row appends the currency, with a debug_assert on the code. CSV_HEADER is now date,account,amount_cents,currency. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, tests/ledger.rs, README.md. Checks: fmt, clippy -D warnings, build and cargo test all pass (9 tests). rustfmt also reflowed two pre-existing lines in lib.rs. Assumptions: an empty fourth column (trailing tab) counts as a malformed currency (exit 2). Line numbers count all input lines, as before. Limits: reports consumer is a separate item.
pr.summary: Made ledger accept an optional ISO 4217 currency column. Now can export currency per row. before: 3-column CSV (date,account,amount_cents), now: 4-column CSV with currency, default USD, malformed code exits 2.
